description: Luck Points. You have a number of Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus and can spend the points on the benefits below. You regain your expended Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest. Advantage. When you roll a d20 for a D20 Test, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on the roll. Disadvantage. When a creature rolls a d20 for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to impose Disadvantage on that roll.

name: Mage Slayer
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Concentration Breaker. When you damage a creature that is concentrating, it has Disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration. Guarded Mind. If you fail an Intelligence, a Wisdom, or a Charisma saving throw, you can cause yourself to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: Magic Connoisseur
description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Additional Spells. Pick a level 1 and a level 2 spell from your Magic Initiate list; both are always prepared and each can be cast free once per Long Rest, or with slots, using your Magic Initiate ability. Spell Change. On gaining a level, swap one for another of the same level from that list.

name: Magic Initiate
description: Two Cantrips. You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat’s spells (choose when you select this feat). Level 1 Spell. Choose a level 1 spell from the same list you selected for this feat’s cantrips. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Spell Change. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the chosen spell list. Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different spell list each time.

name: Mark of Detection
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Deductive Intuition. When you make an Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight) check, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Magical Detection. You always have the Detect Magic and Detect Poison and Disease spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). When you reach character level 3, you also always have the See Invisibility spell prepared and can cast it the same way. Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Detection Spells table are added to that feature's spell list. Mark of Detection Spells

name: Mark of Finding
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Hunter’s Intuition. When you make a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Finder’s Magic. You always have the Hunter’s Mark spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). When you reach character level 3, you also always have the Locate Object spell prepared and can cast it the same way. Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Finding Spells table are added to that feature’s spell list. Mark of Finding Spells

name: Mark of Handling
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Wild Intuition. When you make an Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Animal Handling) check, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Primal Connection. You always have the Animal Friendship and Speak with Animals spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). Monstrous Connections. When you reach character level 3, you can target a Monstrosity when you cast Animal Friendship or Speak with Animals if the creature’s Intelligence score is 3 or lower. Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Handling Spells table are added to that feature’s spell list. Mark of Handling Spells

name: Mark of Healing
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Medical Intuition. When you make a Wisdom (Medicine) check or an ability check using a Herbalism Kit, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Healing Touch. You always have the Cure Wounds spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). When you reach character level 3, you also always have the Lesser Restoration spell prepared and can cast it the same way. Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Healing Spells table are added to that feature’s spell list. Mark of Healing Spells

name: Mark of Hospitality
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Ever Hospitable. When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check or an ability check using Brewer’s Supplies or Cook’s Utensils, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Innkeeper’s Magic. You always have the Purify Food and Drink and Unseen Servant spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). When you reach character level 3, you also always have the Calm Emotions spell prepared and can cast it the same way Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Hospitality Spells table are added to that feature’s spell list. Mark of Hospitality Spells

name: Mark of Making
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Artisan’s Intuition.When you make an Intelligence (Arcana) check or an ability check using Artisan’s Tools, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Spellsmith. You know the Mending cantrip. You also always have the Magic Weapon spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). Spells of the Mark.If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Making Spells table are added to that feature’s spell list. Mark of Making Spells

name: Mark of Passage
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Courier’s Speed. Your Speed increases by 5 feet. Intuitive Motion. When you make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Magical Passage. You always have the Misty Step spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Passage Spells table are added to that feature’s spell list. Mark of Passage Spells

name: Mark of Scribing
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Gifted Scribe. When you make an Intelligence (History) check or an ability check using Calligrapher’s Supplies, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Scribe’s Insight. You know the Message cantrip. You also always have the Comprehend Languages spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). When you reach character level 3, you also always have the Magic Mouth spell prepared and can cast it the same way. Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Scribing Spells table are added to that feature’s spell list. Mark of Scribing Spells

name: Mark of Sentinel
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can't Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Sentinel's Intuition. When you make a Wisdom (Insight or Perception) check, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Guardian's Shield. You always have the Shield spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcsting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). Vigilant Guardian. When a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to swap places with that creature, and you are hit by the attack instead. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spelcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Sentinel Spells table are added to that feature's spell list. Mark of Sentinel Spells

name: Mark of Shadow
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Cunning Intuition. When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) or Charisma (Performance) check, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Shape Shadows. You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. You also always have the Invisibility spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Shadow Spells table are added to that feature’s spell list. Mark of Shadow Spells

name: Mark of Storm
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Windwright’s Intuition. When you make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or an ability check using Navigator’s Tools, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Storm’s Boon. You have Resistance to Lightning damage. Storm Magic. You know the Thunderclap cantrip. When you reach character level 3, you also always have the Gust of Wind spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Storm Spells table are added to that feature’s spell list. Mark of Storm Spells

name: Mark of Warding
prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
description: Warder’s Intuition. When you make an Intelligence (Investigation) check or an ability check using Thieves’ Tools, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. Wards and Seals. You always have the Alarm and Mage Armor spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). When you reach character level 3, you also always have the Arcane Lock spell prepared and can cast it the same way. Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Warding Spells table are added to that feature’s spell list. Mark of Warding Spells

name: Martial Weapon Training
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Weapon Proficiency. You gain proficiency with Martial Weapons.

name: Medium Armor Master
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Dexterous Wearer. While you're wearing Medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2 to your AC if you have a Dexterity score of 16 or higher.

name: Metamagic Adept
description: Learn two Sorcerer metamagic options and gain 2 sorcery points Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature You’ve learned how to exert your will on your spells to alter how they function: You learn two Metamagic options of your choice from the sorcerer class. You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless the option says otherwise. Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace one of these Metamagic options with another one from the sorcerer class. You gain 2 sorcery points to spend on Metamagic (these points are added to any sorcery points you have from another source but can be used only on Metamagic). You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

name: Mist Walker
description: You know how to slip through the Mists’ grasp, but this freedom comes at a price: If you remain in one area for too long, the Mists find you and drain your life force. You gain the following features. Domain Traveler. When you enter the Mists intent on reaching a specific domain, you are treated as if you possess a Mist talisman keyed to that domain. To use this feature, you must know the name of the domain you have chosen as your destination, but you don’t need to have previously visited that land. This trait doesn’t allow you to bypass domain borders closed by a Darklord’s will. Mist Walk. When you take damage or fail a saving throw to avoid or end the Grappled or Restrained condition, you can take a Reaction and teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. Poisoned Roots. When you finish a Long Rest, the world around you in a 10-mile radius becomes a siphon that leeches away at your vitality. Whenever you finish a Short Rest in that area, make a Constitution saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you get no benefits from finishing that rest.

name: Moderately Armored
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Armor Training. You gain training with Medium armor.

name: Mounted Combatant
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Mounted Strike. While mounted, you have Advantage on attack rolls against any unmounted creature within 5 feet of your mount that is at least one size smaller than the mount. Leap Aside. If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails. For your mount to gain this benefit, you must be riding it, and neither of you can have the Incapacitated condition. Veer. While mounted, you can force an attack that hits your mount to hit you instead if you don’t have the Incapacitated condition.

name: Musician
description: Instrument Training. You gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments of your choice. Encouraging Song. As you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can play a song on a Musical Instrument with which you have proficiency and give Heroic Inspiration to allies who hear the song. The number of allies you can affect in this way equals your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Mythal Touched
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Mythal Ward. If a spell attack hits you or you fail a saving throw against a spell, you can take a Reaction to roll on the Mythal-Touched Magic table to create a magical effect. If an effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. Mythal-Touched Magic

name: Necromancy Adept
prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Additional Spells. Always prepared once you have slots of that level: Inflict Wounds (1), Ray of Enfeeblement (2), Vampiric Touch (3), Blight (4), Raise Dead (5). Life Manipulation. When you cast a Necromancy spell with a slot, spend up to two Hit Point Dice and heal the roll plus the slot level.

name: Observant
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Keen Observer. Choose one of the following skills: Insight, Investigation, or Perception. If you lack proficiency with the chosen skill, you gain proficiency in it, and if you already have proficiency in it, you gain Expertise in it. Quick Search. You can take the Search action as a Bonus Action.

name: Orcish Fury
description: +1 Strength or Constitution, additional damage, reaction attack Buff, Combat, Species Feat Prerequisite: Half-orc Your inner fury burns tirelessly. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you hit with an attack using a simple or martial weapon, you can roll one of the weapon’s damage dice an additional time and add it as extra damage of the weapon’s damage type. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest. Immediately after you use your Relentless Endurance trait, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack.

name: Order's Resilience
prerequisite: Level 4+, Tyro of the Gauntlet Feat
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Resurge. When you have the Prone condition, you can right yourself with only 5 feet of movement. Stronger Together. If you are within 5 feet of an ally that doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition, you and that ally have Advantage on Strength saving throws. You can’t use this benefit while you have the Incapacitated condition.

name: Otherworldly Familiar
description: Ability Score Increase. +1 to any ability (max 20). Otherworldly Power. When you cast Find Familiar, it resists your choice of Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder, and it can pass through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (shunted out if it ends a turn inside an object).

name: Outlands Envoy
prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (The Outlands) feat
description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Crossroads Emissary: learn misty step and tongues; cast each once per long rest without a slot (tongues needs no material components), or with slots, using your Scion spellcasting ability.

name: Pack Fighting
description: When you make a melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against a creature, you gain a +1 bonus to the damage roll if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. If at least one ally within 5 feet of the creature also has this feat and doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition, this bonus increases to +2.

name: Piercer
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Puncture. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Piercing damage, you can reroll one of the attack’s damage dice, and you must use the new roll. Enhanced Critical. When you score a Critical Hit that deals Piercing damage to a creature, you can roll one additional damage die when determining the extra Piercing damage the target takes.

name: Planar Wanderer
prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes feat
description: Planar Adaptation: after each long rest, choose resistance to acid, cold or fire until your next long rest. Portal Cracker: as an action, concentrate on a portal within 5 feet and make a DC 20 Int (Arcana) check; on a success force it open or closed for 1 hour (its key works only with a DC 20 Int (Arcana) check as an action), on a failure take 3d8 psychic and can't try that portal again until a long rest. Portal Sense: you know the direction to the last portal you used on the same plane, and once per long rest, as an action, detect portals within 30 feet not behind total cover.

name: Poisoner
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Potent Poison. When you make a damage roll that deals Poison damage, it ignores Resistance to Poison damage. Brew Poison. You gain proficiency with the Poisoner’s Kit. With 1 hour of work using such a kit and expending 50 GP worth of materials, you can create a number of poison doses equal to your Proficiency Bonus. As a Bonus Action, you can apply a poison dose to a weapon or piece of ammunition. Once applied, the poison retains its potency for 1 minute or until you deal damage with the poisoned item, whichever is shorter. When a creature takes damage from the poisoned item, that creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus) or take 2d8 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Polearm Master
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Pole Strike. Immediately after you take the Attack action and attack with a Quarterstaff, a Spear, or a weapon that has the Heavy and Reach properties, you can use a Bonus Action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon. The weapon deals Bludgeoning damage, and the weapon’s damage die for this attack is a d4. Reactive Strike. While you’re holding a Quarterstaff, a Spear, or a weapon that has the Heavy and Reach properties, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against a creature that enters the reach you have with that weapon.

name: Portal Jumper
description: Otherworldly Resilience. Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant (choose one). Portal Step. Spend 15 feet of movement to teleport 15 feet to a space you can see, once per turn, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

name: Potent Dragonmark
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase the spellcasting ability score used by your Dragonmark feat by 1, to a maximum of 20. Dragonmark Preparation. You always have the spells on your Spells of the Mark list (if any) prepared. Dragonmark Spellcasting. You have one extra spell slot to cast the spells granted by your Dragonmark feat. The spell slot’s level is half your level (round up), to a maximum of level 5. You regain the expended slot when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can use this spell slot to cast only a spell you have prepared because of your Dragonmark feat or the Dragonmark Preparation benefit of this feat.

name: Prodigy
description: Gain a Skill and Tool Proficiency, Skill Expertise, and Language Buff, Species Feat Prerequisite: Half-elf, Half-orc, or Human You have a knack for learning new things. You gain the following benefits: You gain one skill proficiency of your choice, one tool proficiency of your choice, and fluency in one language of your choice. Choose one skill in which you have proficiency. You gain expertise with that skill, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with it. The skill you choose must be one that isn’t already benefiting from a feature, such as Expertise, that doubles your proficiency bonus.

name: Prone Fighting
description: While you have the Prone condition, you don’t have Disadvantage due to the Prone condition on attack rolls, and the Prone condition doesn’t grant Advantage on attack rolls made against you.

name: Protection
description: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to interpose your Shield if you’re holding one. You impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll and all other attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn if you remain within 5 feet of the target.

name: Purple Dragon Commandant
prerequisite: Level 4+, Purple Dragon Rook Feat or Martial Weapon Proficiency
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Encourage Ally. As a Bonus Action, you bolster one ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 plus the modifier of the ability score increased by this feat. You can take this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest. Last Stand. You have Advantage on attack rolls while Bloodied.

name: Purple Dragon Rook
description: Entreat. You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Rallying Cry. When you roll Initiative and don’t have the Incapacitated condition, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus that you can see within 30 feet of yourself. Those creatures gain Heroic Inspiration. Once you use this benefit, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

name: Putrefy
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. Necrosis. When you make a damage roll that deals Necrotic damage, you can cause one creature taking that damage to have the Poisoned condition until the start of your next turn. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: Rebuke
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. Radiant Strike. When you make a damage roll that deals Radiant damage, you can cause one Huge or smaller creature taking the damage to have the Prone condition. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: Resilient
description: Ability Score Increase. Choose one ability in which you lack saving throw proficiency. Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Saving Throw Proficiency. You gain saving throw proficiency with the chosen ability.

name: Revenant Blade
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity, gain finesse with double-bladed weapons. Damage, Combat, Species Feat Prerequisite: Elf You are descended from a master of the double-bladed scimitar, and some of that mastery has passed on to you. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. While you are holding a double-bladed scimitar with two hands, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class. A double-bladed scimitar has the finesse property when you wield it. To gain the weapon benefits of this feat, equip a Revenant Double-Bladed Scimitar or create your own similar weapon.

name: Righteous Heritor
prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Good) feat
description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Soothe Pain: when you or a creature within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction to reduce it by 1d10 + proficiency bonus. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

name: Ritual Caster
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Ritual Spells. Choose a number of level 1 spells equal to your Proficiency Bonus that have the Ritual tag. You always have those spells prepared, and you can cast them with any spell slots you have. The spells’ spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. Whenever your Proficiency Bonus increases thereafter, you can add an additional level 1 spell with the Ritual tag to the spells always prepared with this feature. Quick Ritual. With this benefit, you can cast a Ritual spell that you have prepared using its regular casting time rather than the extended time for a Ritual. Doing so doesn’t require a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can’t use this benefit again until you finish a Long Rest.

name: Rune Shaper
prerequisite: Spellcasting feature or Rune Carver background
description: Learn comprehend languages; cast it once per long rest without a slot, or with any slots. Rune Magic: you know runes equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down). After each long rest, inscribe each on a nonmagical object you touch and know its 1st-level spell until your next long rest; while carrying a marked object, cast that spell with your slots, or once per long rest per rune without a slot or material components. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the ability (chosen with this feat). Swap one rune each level. Runes: Cloud fog cloud, Death inflict wounds, Dragon chromatic orb, Enemy disguise self, Fire burning hands, Friend speak with animals, Frost armor of Agathys, Hill goodberry, Journey longstrider, King command, Mountain entangle, Stone sanctuary, Storm thunderwave.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Savage Attacker
description: You’ve trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon’s damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

name: Scion of the Outer Planes
description: Choose a plane type for a damage resistance and a cantrip (cast without material components; Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma chosen with this feat). Chaotic: poison, minor illusion. Evil: necrotic, chill touch. Good: radiant, sacred flame. Lawful: force, guidance. The Outlands: psychic, mage hand.

name: Second Chance
description: +1 Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma, impose attack disadvantage Buff, Debuff, Species Feat Prerequisite: Halfling Fortune favors you when someone tries to strike you. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force that creature to reroll. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you roll initiative at the start of combat or until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Second Skin
description: There is another side of you that most people never see: a beast, a terrifying avenger, or a walking nightmare. You gain the following features. Alternate Form. You always have the Alter Self spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot or spell components, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). When you cast Alter Self without a spell slot using this feature, it doesn’t require Concentration. Involuntary Change. Certain circumstances can involuntarily trigger your transformation. When you select this feat, roll on the Change Catalyst table to determine what triggers your change. After you experience the catalyst, at the start of your next turn, make a Charisma saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you immediately use Alternate Form to cast Alter Self without a spell slot. If you’ve already expended the use of that feature, you instead have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn. Change Catalyst

name: Sentinel
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Guardian. Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you takes the Disengage action or hits a target other than you with an attack, you can make an Opportunity Attack against that creature. Halt. When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, the creature’s Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the current turn.

name: Shadow Touched
description: Your exposure to the Shadowfell’s magic grants you the following benefits. Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Shadow Magic. Choose one level 1 spell from the Illusion or Necromancy school of magic. You always have that spell and the Invisibility spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can’t cast that spell in this way again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells’ spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Shadowmoor Hexer
description: Hex. You always have the Hex spell prepared. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Curse Magic. When a creature that you’ve cursed with Hex hits you with an attack roll, the creature takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

name: Sharp Eye
description: When you take the Search or Study action, you can give yourself Advantage on any ability check made as part of that action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. If the check fails, the use of this feature isn’t expended.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Bypass Cover. Your ranged attacks with weapons ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover. Firing in Melee. Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons. Long Shots. Attacking at long range doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

name: Shield Master
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Shield Bash. If you attack a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the Attack action and hit with a Melee weapon, you can immediately bash the target with your Shield if it’s equipped, forcing the target to make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you either push the target 5 feet from you or cause it to have the Prone condition (your choice). You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns. Interpose Shield. If you’re subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can take a Reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and are holding a Shield.

name: Shifting Combatant
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Domino Strike. When you hit a creature with a weapon and activate the Push mastery property to push that creature into a space occupied by a Large or smaller creature, you can force the creatures to collide. Each creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Prone condition. Fearless Leap. When you make a Long Jump, moving at least 10 feet immediately before the jump, and land in a space within 5 feet of two or more enemies, attack rolls made against you have Disadvantage until the start of your next turn.

name: Skill Expert
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. Skill Proficiency. You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Expertise. Choose one skill in which you have proficiency but lack Expertise. You gain Expertise with that skill.

name: Skilled
description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice. Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once.

name: Skulker
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Blindsight. You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet. Fog of War. You exploit the distractions of battle, gaining Advantage on any Dexterity (Stealth) check you make as part of the Hide action during combat. Sniper. If you make an attack roll while hidden and the roll misses, making the attack roll doesn't reveal your location.

name: Slasher
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Hamstring. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Slashing damage, you can reduce the Speed of that creature by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Enhanced Critical. When you score a Critical Hit that deals Slashing damage to a creature, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

name: Soothing Familiar
description: Ability Score Increase. +1 to any ability (max 20). Healing Beacon. While your familiar is within 120 feet of you, allies within 5 feet of it treat 1s and 2s on healing dice as 3s.

name: Soul of the Storm Giant
prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Storm Strike) feat
description: +1 Strength, Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Maelstrom Aura: as a bonus action, a 10-foot aura surrounds you until the start of your next turn (or until incapacitated): you resist lightning and thunder, attacks against you have disadvantage, and a creature starting its turn in it can be forced to make a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the raised ability's modifier) or have half speed until the start of its next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Speedy
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Speed Increase. Your Speed increases by 10 feet. Dash over Difficult Terrain. When you take the Dash action on your turn, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement for the rest of that turn. Agile Movement. Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

name: Spell Resistant
description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Dexterity or Constitution (max 20). Magical Resilience. Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder (choose one). Magic Resistant. When you would fail a save against a spell or magical effect, add 1d6, possibly turning it into a success; Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

name: Spell Sniper
prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Bypass Cover. Your attack rolls for spells ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover. Casting in Melee. Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with spells. Increased Range. When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 10 feet and requires you to make an attack roll, you can increase the spell’s range by 60 feet.

name: Spell Subterfuge
prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Shrouding Spells. After casting an action spell with a slot, take Dash and Hide together as a Bonus Action; uses equal to the increased ability's modifier per Long Rest. Sneaky Casting. Verbal components and spell attacks don't end your Hide-granted Invisible condition if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover.

name: Spellfire Adept
prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellfire Spark Feat or the Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Fueled Spellfire. Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant damage, you can expend up to two Hit Point Dice, roll them, and add the total rolled to one damage roll of the spell. Searing Spellfire. When you make a damage roll that deals Radiant damage, it ignores Resistance to Radiant damage.

name: Spellfire Spark
description: Magic Absorption. Once per turn, when you take damage from a spell or magical effect, you reduce the total damage taken by 1d4. You can’t use this benefit if you have the Incapacitated condition. Spellfire Flame. You learn the Sacred Flame cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can also cast this cantrip as a Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Squat Nimbleness
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity, +5 ft. Speed, Acrobatics or Athletics proficiency Buff, Movement, Species Feat Prerequisite: Dwarf or a Small race You are uncommonly nimble for your race. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Increase your walking speed by 5 feet. You gain proficiency in the Acrobatics or Athletics skill (your choice). You have advantage on any Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check you make to escape from being grappled.

name: Squire of Solamnia
prerequisite: Dragonlance Campaign, Fighter or Paladin class or Knight of Solamnia background
description: Mount Up: mounting or dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement. Precise Strike: once per turn, give a weapon attack roll against a creature advantage; on a hit add 1d8 to the damage. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest, spent only on a hit.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Street Justice
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Headlock. Your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you. Sturdy Knot. When you use Chain, Manacles, or Rope to bind a creature, add your Proficiency Bonus to the DC to escape or burst the Chain, Manacles, or Rope. Tough Talk. A creature’s Hostile attitude doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your Charisma (Intimidation) checks to influence that creature.

name: Strike of the Giants
prerequisite: Martial weapon proficiency or Giant Foundling background
description: Choose one strike. Once per turn when you hit with a melee or thrown weapon attack, add its effect (save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Str or Con modifier); proficiency bonus uses per long rest. Cloud: +1d4 thunder, and on a failed Wis save you are invisible to the creature until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast. Fire: +1d10 fire. Frost: +1d6 cold, and on a failed Con save its speed is 0 until the start of your next turn. Hill: +1d6 of the weapon's type, and on a failed Str save it falls prone. Stone: +1d6 force, and on a failed Str save it is pushed 10 feet. Storm: +1d6 lightning, and on a failed Con save it has disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Survivor
description: Hypervigilance. Whenever you roll Initiative, you can reroll the d20 if the number rolled is 9 or lower. You must use the new roll. Steel Yourself. When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to add a bonus to the roll, potentially causing it to succeed. The bonus is equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once you take this Reaction, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

name: Symbiotic Being
description: A second being lives inside you, aiding you while pursuing its own agenda. Entwined Existence. The symbiote can't be targeted; it dies if you die and revives if you are revived. Second Mind. Gain proficiency in Arcana, Deception, History, Intimidation, Insight, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Perception or Persuasion, and learn one language. Sustained Symbiosis. When you fail a saving throw, take a Reaction and expend a Hit Die, adding its roll to the save. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest. Symbiotic Agenda. Immediately after you roll a 1 on a D20 Test, make a Charisma save (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus). On a failure you are Charmed for 1d12 hours and must further the symbiote's goals as the DM decides; repeat the save whenever you take damage. The DM may also call for this save when you act against the symbiote's agenda.

name: Tactical Combatant
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Buffering Strike. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the total number rolled on the weapon’s damage dice. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest. Honed Instincts. When you fail an ability check, you can roll 1d6 and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: Enhanced Unarmed Strike. When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike. Damage Rerolls. Whenever you roll a damage die for your Unarmed Strike, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll. Improvised Weaponry. You have proficiency with improvised weapons. Push. When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can deal damage to the target and also push it 5 feet away from you. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

name: Telekinetic
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Minor Telekinesis. You learn the Mage Hand spell. You can cast it without Verbal or Somatic components, you can make the spectral hand Invisible, and its range and the distance it can be away from you both increase by 30 feet when you cast it. The spell’s spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. Telekinetic Shove. As a Bonus Action, you can telekinetically shove one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. When you do so, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus) or be moved 5 feet toward or away from you.

name: Telepathic
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Telepathic Utterance. You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. Your communication doesn’t give the creature the ability to respond to you telepathically. Detect Thoughts. You always have the Detect Thoughts spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot or spell components, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
description: When you hit with a ranged attack roll using a weapon that has the Thrown property, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

name: Tireless Reveler
description: When an ally you can see within 60 feet of yourself expends Heroic Inspiration, you can gain Heroic Inspiration if you lack it. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: Touch of Death
description: Deathly power resides within you, bursting out at the slightest provocation. You gain the following features. Death Touch. You learn the Chill Touch spell and can cast it without spell components. Necrotic damage you deal with this spell ignores Resistance. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). Pull of the Grave. You have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.

name: Tough
description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your Hit Point maximum increases by an additional 2 Hit Points.

name: Transmutation Adept
prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Additional Spells. Always prepared once you have slots of that level: Jump (1), Spider Climb (2), Slow (3), Polymorph (4), Animate Objects (5). Magical Augmentation. When you cast a Transmutation spell with a slot on your turn, gain Speed equal to 5 times the slot level until the turn ends.

name: Transmutation Adept (DMAU)
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Enchanting Presence. You always have the Charm Person spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat. Inevitable Betrayal. You have Advantage on attack rolls against creatures with the Charmed condition.

name: Transmuted Anatomy
description: Lengthened Stride. Speed +5 feet. Resilient Anatomy. Advantage on saves against being forcibly shape-shifted. When you fail a Constitution save, use a Reaction to add 1d4, possibly turning it into a success; Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
description: When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren’t already adding it to the damage.

name: Tyro of the Gauntlet
description: Stand as One. When an ally within 5 feet of you is subjected to an effect that would push or pull it, you can take a Reaction to prevent that ally from being pushed or pulled. To receive this benefit, the ally can’t have the Incapacitated condition. Vigilant. When you take the Ready action, the next attack roll made against you has Disadvantage before the start of your next turn.

name: Unarmed Fighting
description: When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike. If you aren’t holding any weapons or a Shield when you make the attack roll, the d6 becomes a d8. At the start of each of your turns, you can deal 1d4 Bludgeoning damage to one creature Grappled by you.

name: Vampire Hunter
description: Adroit Escape. You have Advantage on checks to escape from nonmagical restraints or the Grappled condition. Vitality Ward. When you take Necrotic damage, you can take a Reaction to mitigate the damage. Roll a number of d6s equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and add them together. Reduce the Necrotic damage you take by this total. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: Vampire Touched
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Vampire Magic. Choose one level 1 spell from the Enchantment or Illusion school of magic. You always have that spell and the Spider Climb spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot, but when you cast Spider Climb this way, you must target yourself, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast each spell in this way again. You can also cast either spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spells is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Vampire's Plaything
description: Decanting. When you finish a Long Rest, you can create one Potion of Healing or an Antitoxin, as long as you have an empty vial or flask. These liquids evaporate when you finish another Long Rest. Timely Retreat. You can take a Bonus Action to take the Dash action or the Disengage action. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you recover all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. Vampiric Connection. The DM determines the fate of your former vampire master. While you and your former vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with you telepathically, and you can choose to allow the vampire to perceive through your senses.

name: Vigor of the Hill Giant
prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Hill Strike) feat
description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom (max 20). Bulwark: when an effect would move you 5 feet or more or knock you prone, use your reaction to stay put and standing. Iron Stomach: when you eat during a short rest and spend Hit Dice, regain extra HP equal to your Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: War Caster
prerequisite: Level 4+ Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Concentration. You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration. Reactive Spell. When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you by leaving your reach, you can take a Reaction to cast a spell at the creature rather than making an Opportunity Attack. The spell must have a casting time of one action and must target only that creature. Somatic Components. You can perform the Somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a Shield in one or both hands.

name: Warlike Familiar
description: Ability Score Increase. +1 to any ability (max 20). Battle Familiar. The Battle Familiar spell is always prepared; cast it free once per Long Rest or with slots, using your Familiar Friend ability. Intercept Attack. When a creature within 5 feet of your familiar is hit, the familiar's Reaction adds your Proficiency Bonus to that creature's AC against the attack.

name: Watchers
description: Something unnatural is always watching you, taking the form of scurrying vermin and other eerie creatures. You gain the following features. Borrowed Eyes. You always have the Beast Sense and Speak with Animals spells prepared. You can cast each spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Heightened Suspicion. Whenever you take the Search action, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to any ability check made as part of that action. Incessant Watchers. You have Disadvantage on saving throws made against the Scrying spell. In addition, immediately after you make a D20 Test and roll a 1 on the d20, paranoia threatens to overwhelm you. Make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you have Disadvantage on D20 Tests for 1 minute. You can repeat the save at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect early on a success.

name: Weapon Master
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity Score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Mastery Property. Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery property of one kind of Simple or Martial weapon of your choice, provided you have proficiency with it. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kind of weapon to another eligible kind.

name: Wood Elf Magic
description: Learn the magic of the primeval woods Buff, Movement, Species Feat Prerequisite: Elf (wood) You learn the magic of the primeval woods, which are revered and protected by your people. You learn one druid cantrip of your choice. You also learn the longstrider and pass without trace spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast these two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

name: Zhentarim Ruffian
description: Exploit Opening. When you roll damage for an Opportunity Attack, you can roll the damage dice twice and use either roll against the target. Family First. If you have Heroic Inspiration when you roll Initiative, you can expend it to give yourself and your allies Advantage on that Initiative roll.

name: Zhentarim Tactics
description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Retaliate. Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can make an Opportunity Attack against that creature. Versatile Merc. When you finish a Long Rest, choose a skill in which you have proficiency. You have Expertise in that skill until you finish your next Long Rest.

name: Adept of the Black Robes
prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Nuitari) feat
description: Ambitious Magic: learn one 2nd-level enchantment or necromancy spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Life Channel: when a creature you can see within 60 feet fails a save against a damaging spell you cast, spend Hit Dice equal to the spell's level, roll them, and add the total to its damage.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Adept of the Red Robes
prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Lunitari) feat
description: Insightful Magic: learn one 2nd-level illusion or transmutation spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Magical Balance: when you roll 9 or lower on the d20 for an attack roll or ability check, treat it as a 10; proficiency bonus times per long rest.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Shadow Pact
description: Darkvision: 60 feet, or +30 feet if you already have it. Shadow Blood: when you roll a 1 on a die for Hit Points you regain while entirely in Dim Light or Darkness, reroll it and use the new roll. Shroud of Shadows: as a Bonus Action, radiate a 5-foot Emanation of Dim Light for 1 minute (ends if you dismiss it or are Incapacitated); once per Short or Long Rest.

name: Shadow Trapper
description: +1 Strength or Wisdom (max 20). Dangerous Shroud: Advantage on attack rolls against creatures inside your Shroud of Shadows. Sorrowful Embrace: at the start of each of its turns, a creature you have Grappled makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + the raised ability's modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or takes 1d4 + that modifier Psychic damage.

name: Shadow Weaver
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Create Shadow: Darkness is always prepared; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots, using the raised ability. Manipulate Shadow: as a Bonus Action, grow or shrink a Darkness you cast by 5 feet (radius 5 to 25 feet) or move its area to a point within 60 feet.

name: Fey Tormentor
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Faerie Time Warp: once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action, up to three creatures you can see within 60 feet make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + the raised ability's modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or lose 10 feet of Speed and take a -2 AC penalty until the end of your next turn. Hag's Hex: Hex is always prepared; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots, using the raised ability. At character level 5, Bestow Curse works the same way.

name: Blood Hound
description: You notice any Small or larger creature that moves within 10 feet of you while you aren't Unconscious, and you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sound or smell.

name: Convincing Inquisitor
description: Influence actions: no Disadvantage against Hostile creatures and Advantage against Indifferent ones, and you can use any ability modifier for Intimidation or Persuasion. When a Search with Insight catches a lie or evasion, you have Advantage on Initiative against that creature for 1 hour.

name: Deathbound
description: With two failed Death Saves you have Advantage on Death Saves until you are above 0 HP. When you spend Hit Dice on a Short Rest, roll each twice and keep the higher.

name: Fortune of the Thaumaturge
description: PB times per Long Rest, when you fail a D20 Test spend and roll a Hit Die and add it (once per test). If the die shows its highest or lowest number, you regain that Hit Die.

name: Free Sword Mercenary's Will
description: When a creature moves you without using your movement, take a Reaction to reduce the distance by up to your Speed. Advantage on saves that would apply a condition.

name: Insightful Collector
description: A Study action identifies a magic item's properties and use without attuning (not curses), with a cumulative 5% chance per rarity step above Common of getting it wrong. You start with a Common magic item chosen with your GM.

name: Resolution of the Syndicate
description: On your first turn after rolling Initiative, add 1d4 to your first damage roll (2d4 at level 9, 4d4 at level 16). HP maximum increases by your character level, and by 1 per level after.

name: Triage Expert
description: Blood and Bone: Utilize action and a Healer's Kit use lets a creature within 5 feet spend and roll a Hit Die to heal. Bedside Manner: whenever you restore HP or use Blood and Bone, roll one extra die and drop the lowest.

name: Blackpowder Pistol Expert
description: +1 Dexterity, Constitution, or Intelligence (max 20). No Disadvantage at long range with Blackpowder Pistols, ignore their Loading property, and when a creature within 5 feet of you moves, take a Reaction to shoot it with one.

name: Expanded Grip
description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution (max 20). A Versatile weapon used in one hand deals its two-handed damage in melee. When an effect would make you drop what you hold, make a DC 15 Strength save to keep it, and you have Advantage on saves to keep your grip.

name: Hulking Figure
description: +1 Strength or Constitution (max 20). Once per turn an Unarmed Strike hit deals +1d4 Bludgeoning. Add Str mod to Intimidation, Performance, and Persuasion checks. Count one size larger (max Large) for carrying.

name: Iron Gut
description: +1 Strength, Constitution, or Charisma (max 20). Advantage on saves against Poisoned and on Survival checks to forage. Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Bonus Action spend a Hit Die and heal its roll + Con mod.

name: Lightning Caster
prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). When you cast a single-target action cantrip, a Bonus Action lets it target a second creature in range. Once per Long Rest, a spell you cast as a Reaction uses no slot.

name: Medician of the Morbus Doctore
description: Blood and Bone lets the creature spend up to three Hit Dice, or spend three to end Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned instead of healing (or cure one Grievous Wound).

name: Nimble Physique
description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution (max 20). Without armor or a Shield, Dodge as a Bonus Action. While Grappled or Restrained your attacks don't have Disadvantage and attacks against you don't have Advantage.

name: Sangromantic Initiate
prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
description: Pick a Sangromancy spell of a level you have slots for: always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots. You also have two d12 Sangromancy Dice to spend instead of Hit Dice on Sangromancy spells, refilled on a Long Rest.

name: Shadowsteel Adept
prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Shadowsteel curses are always prepared and castable with any slots. While holding your Shadowsteel Focus, +1 to spell attacks and spell save DCs, and if it is a weapon it is +1.

name: Shadowsteel Master
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). With your Shadowsteel Focus, one creature you hit or that fails a save against your slot spell takes 1d4 Necrotic per slot level. A weapon Focus becomes +2 and once per turn adds 2d8 Necrotic on a hit.

name: Syndicate Spy
description: Proficiency with Thieves' Tools (craft a key in 10 minutes with the lock), Disguise Kit (10-minute costume changes your apparent features and even species, not size or shape), and Forgery Kit (no word limit mimicking handwriting). Hide from non-Hostile creatures while only Lightly Obscured, using Charisma if you like.

name: Thrown Weapon Master
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity (max 20). After an Attack action with a Simple Thrown weapon, make two more Simple Thrown attacks as a Bonus Action. As a Bonus Action, gather and stow or wield all Simple Thrown weapons within 5 feet (free hand needed). Your proficient Simple Thrown weapons gain the Returning property.

name: Witch Hunter
description: +1 Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom (max 20). When a spell targets only you with no area, take a Reaction for a Wisdom save against its DC; on a success the caster must pick a new target or the spell is wasted. Melee or Unarmed Strike hits on spellcasters cut their Speed by 15 feet until your next turn. Advantage on saves against Shadowsteel curses and spells lasting over 10 minutes.

name: Advanced Weapon Proficiency
prerequisite: Fighting Style feature (or level 8+ as a General feat)
description: Proficiency with Advanced weapons, including use of their mastery properties.

name: Close Combat Artillerist
description: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't give your Ranged weapon attacks Disadvantage, and your ranged hits on creatures within 5 feet deal +2 damage.

name: Dual Shot
description: When you attack with a bow or crossbow as part of the Attack action, you can add one extra attack against a creature within 10 feet of the first target; both attacks have Disadvantage.

name: Flurry
description: Once per turn, give up Advantage on a weapon or Unarmed Strike attack; afterward attack a different creature within 5 feet of the first target and in reach.

name: Mobile Combatant
description: When you take the Attack action, your Speed increases by 10 feet and Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage until the end of your turn.

name: Opportunist
description: Attacks you make as part of a Reaction get +2 to attack and damage rolls.

name: Prone Defense
description: Being Prone doesn't give your attacks Disadvantage or attacks against you Advantage, and standing up costs only 5 feet of movement.

name: Boon of Magic Resistance
description: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom (max 30). Once per Short or Long Rest, turn a failed saving throw into a success.

name: Boon of Perfect Flight
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity (max 30). Fly Speed 40 feet with hover, and falls slow to 60 feet per round.

name: Brutal Grip
description: +1 Strength (max 20). Wield a Two-Handed melee weapon in one hand, and a Versatile melee weapon held in one hand counts as Light.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Field Commander
description: +1 Charisma (max 20). As an action, an ally within 60 feet who hears you can immediately use its Reaction to Attack (one attack), Dash, Dodge, Hide, Influence, Search, Study, or Utilize. Enemies can't have Advantage on attacks against you while you're within 5 feet of two or more active allies.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Focused Critical
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity (max 20). Your weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks crit on 19 or 20.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Iron Hero
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity (max 20). +2 AC against attacks from creatures whose CR exceeds your level. Advantage on attacks against a creature that dropped an ally to 0 HP since your last turn. PB times per Long Rest, take a Reaction to stop a Legendary Action you can see.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Familiar Keeper
description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). Find Familiar always prepared, once per Long Rest as a Magic action with no slot or components; your familiar can also be an Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, Sphinx of Wonder, or Sprite. PB times per Long Rest, take a Reaction to give Disadvantage to an attack made by a creature within 5 feet of your familiar.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Flex Caster
description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). When casting a spell that scales, spend an extra slot to raise its effective level by 1 (max 9). Or cast a spell with a higher slot at its base level and regain a level 1 slot.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Magitechnician
description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). Your magic items' save DCs can use 8 + that ability's modifier + PB if higher. Once per Long Rest, after a Short Rest, recharge one magic item as if it were dawn.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Metabolistic Magic
prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). When you fail a D20 Test, spend a spell slot to add 2 + its level. Once per Long Rest, after a Short Rest, spend up to PB Hit Dice to recover spell slots of that total level.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Pyromaniac
description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). Learn Fire Bolt and always have Burning Hands and Scorching Ray prepared, each once per Long Rest without a slot. When a Fire damage die rolls its maximum, roll it again and add it, repeating, up to PB extra dice.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Shock Trooper
description: +1 Str or Dex (max 20). When you roll Initiative without Disadvantage, draw a weapon and attack with it. Your Speed is doubled during the first round of combat.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Showman
description: +1 Cha (max 20). Performance proficiency, or Expertise if you have it. PB times per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action taunt a creature within 15 feet that can hear you: Disadvantage on its next attack against anyone else before the end of its next turn.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Spellblade
description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). Learn two of Arc Blade, Burning Blade, Frigid Blade, or True Strike (swappable each level), and replace one Attack action attack with casting one. PB times per Long Rest, add your Int, Wis, or Cha mod (min +1) to a proficient weapon attack roll.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Altered
description: An obvious augmentation of your choice. Aquatic Adaptation: breathe water and Swim Speed equal to your Speed. Natural Armor: AC 13 + Dex or Con mod. Natural Weapons: Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing. Night Vision: Darkvision 60 feet (or +30).

name: Charm Twister
description: Old Blessing: once per Long Rest cast Bless only on creatures carrying your wicker charms (or with slots), using Int, Wis, or Cha. Twisted Hex: as a Magic action curse a charm with an ability; whoever carries it, or whose home holds it, has Disadvantage on checks and attacks with that ability, and on such a failure can make a Cha save (DC 8 + PB + that modifier) to destroy it. One hex charm at a time.

name: Crimson Ritualist
description: Learn the Blood Bolt cantrip (Int, Wis, or Cha). After a Long Rest, a 1-minute ritual bleeds up to PB Hit Dice into a vial; a creature drinking it as a Bonus Action rolls those dice and heals the total + its Con mod. It keeps until your next Long Rest.

name: Cult Initiate
description: Learn two Warlock cantrips and always have one level 1 Warlock spell prepared, castable once per Short or Long Rest without a slot or with slots (Int, Wis, or Cha). Swap one choice when you gain a level.

name: Dread Speech
description: Eldritch Word: as a Bonus Action a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save (DC 8 + PB + Int, Wis, or Cha mod) or is Frightened until your next turn; free once per Short or Long Rest, and extra uses cost you 1d6 Necrotic that can't be reduced. Shred Fate: Bane always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components.

name: Fate Gambler
description: Gain Heroic Inspiration (if you lack it) when you win a contested check, drop a creature to 0 HP, or a creature fails a save you forced, unless it has no CR or CR 0. As a Bonus Action spend Heroic Inspiration for temp HP equal to your level.

name: Ghostlight Medium
description: Ignore the damage Resistances of creatures with Incorporeal Movement. Once per Short or Long Rest after a detection, as a Bonus Action sense the distance and direction of Undead and Ethereal creatures within 60 feet.

name: Grave Keeper
description: Gain one Channel Divinity use for Turn Undead (DC 8 + Wis mod + PB), or add a use to an existing Channel Divinity. A 10-minute rite with 10 GP of trappings keeps a Medium or smaller corpse from becoming Undead.

name: Hunter of Hunters
description: As a Bonus Action study a creature; your next damage to it before your next turn ignores its Resistances. Advantage on checks to recall lore about creatures.

name: Memory Starved
description: Advantage on Investigation checks, and on saves against Charmed and against having your memories read or altered.

name: Reveling Fool
description: A fool's mask and costume give you a separate identity that can get away with small affronts to authority. Hideous Laughter always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components (Int, Wis, or Cha).

name: Unreflected
description: You cast no reflection or shadow. Insight checks against you have Disadvantage. Among at least two creatures of your type within one size of you, you can Hide from those outside the group with Deception instead of Stealth, needing no cover; straying more than 5 feet from them reveals you.

name: Death Defier
description: +1 Constitution (max 20). Add Con mod (min 1) to Death Saving Throws. Once per Long Rest, an effect that would kill you outright or drop you to 0 HP without damage leaves you at HP equal to your level.

name: Swift Witchcraft
prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). Once per Long Rest, cast a 1-minute spell as an action.

name: Blessing of Baldur
description: Protective Aegis: once per Long Rest, when you or an ally within 10 feet takes damage, use your Reaction to reduce it by your Proficiency Bonus + Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Radiant Aura: as a Bonus Action, shed bright light 10 feet and dim light 10 more (Bonus Action to end). Sunlance: you know Sacred Flame (Charisma).

name: Blessing of Boreas
description: Cold Aegis: when you take Cold damage, use your Reaction to gain Resistance to Cold until the end of your next turn, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Winter Magic: you know Ray of Frost and always have Armor of Agathys or Ice Knife prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).

name: Blessing of Eir
description: You have Vitality Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest. Vitality Surge: Bonus Action and 1 point to regain 1d4 Hit Points, or stabilize yourself while Dying (no action). Channel Vitality: Bonus Action and 1 point to heal a creature you touch 1d4.

name: Blessing of Freyr and Freyja
description: Proficiency in Animal Handling or Nature. You learn Druidcraft and Thorn Whip and always have Entangle or Hail of Thorns prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).

name: Blessing of Jormungandr
description: Poison Resilience: when you take Poison damage, use your Reaction to gain Resistance to Poison until the end of your next turn, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Serpent Kinship: Animal Friendship and Speak with Animals always prepared, each once per Long Rest without a slot (snakes and serpents only) or with slots. You know Draconic.

name: Blessing of Loki
description: Proficiency in Deception (Expertise if already proficient). You learn Minor Illusion and Vicious Mockery and always have Disguise Self or Charm Person prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).

name: Blessing of Sif
description: Gift of Dexterity: add your Proficiency Bonus to a Dexterity check (again if already added), Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. You know True Strike and always have Hunter's Mark or Longstrider prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

name: Blessing of Thor
description: Gift of Strength: add your Proficiency Bonus to a Strength check (again if already added), Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. You know Shocking Grasp or Thunderclap and always have Thunderous Smite prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

name: Blessing of Volund
description: Proficiency with one Artisan's Tool (Advantage with it if already proficient). You learn Elementalism and Mending and always have Burning Hands or Shield prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

name: Blessing of Wotan
description: Proficiency in Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion (Expertise if already proficient). You know Guidance and always have one level 1 spell of your choice prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

name: Brewer
