description: Proficiency with Brewer's Supplies and a 50% discount on food and drink. After a Long Rest with Brewer's Supplies you brew a mead; a creature that drinks it (Utilize action) gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. It keeps until your next Long Rest.

name: Cold Plunge Training
description: In water you have Advantage on saves against extreme cold and on Strength (Athletics) checks to swim. On a turn you dive from land into water, you swim at full Speed.

name: Fisher
description: Proficiency in Survival. Advantage on d20 Tests to operate water vehicles. With access to water, 1 hour of fishing feeds up to 6 people for a day.

name: Norn-Touched
description: Fates' Favor: once per day, add your Proficiency Bonus to a d20 Test after seeing the roll. Fates' Scorn: once per day, subtract your Proficiency Bonus from another creature's attack roll or ability check after seeing the roll.

name: Northern Raider
description: Proficiency with Navigator's Tools. Advantage on attack rolls and ability checks on a turn you exit the water or a ship.

name: Sea Wolf
description: Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks to board vehicles. When you score a melee Critical Hit, make another melee attack against that creature or an adjacent one as a Bonus Action.

name: Snowrunner
description: Advantage on saves and checks to keep your balance on slippery surfaces and snow, and on Wisdom (Survival) checks in snowy or icy terrain.

name: Well-Versed
description: Proficiency with one musical instrument and one of Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. Give yourself Advantage on an Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) check Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

name: Axe Fighter
prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength 13+, Proficiency with Martial Weapons
description: +1 Strength. Once per turn when you hit with a Handaxe, attack with a Handaxe as a Bonus Action. Battleaxe Topple saves have Disadvantage. Greataxe Cleave reaches extra creatures equal to half your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Axe Thrower
description: +1 Strength. When you miss a ranged attack with a thrown Handaxe, use a Bonus Action that turn to catch it as it returns.

name: Battle Cry
description: +1 Strength or Charisma. As a Bonus Action once per Short Rest, roll Charisma (Intimidation); a creature that can hear you within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save against the result or is Frightened for 1d4 rounds (save each turn). Two creatures at level 9; three and 60 feet at level 15.

name: Blessing of Angrboda and Bergelmir
prerequisite: Level 4+, Giantkin or Trollkin (or GM permission)
description: +1 Strength or Wisdom. Thunderous Strike: add 1d6 Thunder to a melee weapon hit, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Prophetic Vision: once per Long Rest as a Magic action, cast a 1-action Divination spell of a level up to half your character level without a slot (Wisdom).

name: Blessing of Bragi
description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Proficiency in Persuasion and Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

name: Blessing of Heimdall
description: +1 Strength or Constitution. Proficiency in Perception (Expertise if already proficient), and give yourself Advantage on Perception checks Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Proficiency with the horn. Once per Long Rest, reroll Initiative and use the new result.

name: Blessing of Hel
description: Advantage on Death Saving Throws. When you become Stable after a third success or are stabilized by another creature, regain 1d6 + Proficiency Bonus Hit Points. You know Spare the Dying and Toll the Dead (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).

name: Blessing of Njord
description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Cast Find Steed (a sea serpent) once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots. You breathe water, automatically succeed on saves against extreme cold while submerged, and have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Blessing of Skadi
description: +1 Constitution. Once per Short or Long Rest, give yourself Advantage on a ranged weapon attack made with the Attack action. +10 feet Speed on ice or snow, which are never Difficult Terrain for you.

name: Blessing of the Snow Queen
description: +1 Constitution. You know Ice Knife and can cast it without a slot Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, or with slots. Once per Long Rest, turn a failed save against a Cold-damage spell or effect into a success.

name: Blessing of Tyr
description: +1 Strength or Charisma. Advantage on saves to avoid or end Frightened. Justicar: as a Magic action, touch a creature; on a failed Charisma save it can't deliberately lie for 1 minute (once per Long Rest per creature).

name: Blood of the Berserker
description: +1 Strength or Constitution. Once per Long Rest while Bloodied, enter a 1-minute fury as a Bonus Action: melee weapon attacks deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you don't fall Unconscious at 0 Hit Points (you still make Death Saves).

name: Bloodied Resilience
description: +1 Constitution. While Bloodied, when you take damage, spend a Hit Die as a Reaction to reduce it by the roll. A successful Strength or Constitution save against half-damage effects means no damage.

name: Bloody Resolve
description: +1 Constitution. When you take damage, +1 to saves until the end of your next turn; while Bloodied, +2 to saves and +1 to attack and damage rolls instead.

name: Boisterous Roar
description: +1 Charisma. When you score a Critical Hit, you and allies within 5 feet have Resistance to all damage and enemies within 5 feet have Vulnerability to all damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Brazen Courage
description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Advantage on saves against Frightened, and end Frightened on yourself as a Bonus Action Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

name: Chosen by Fate
description: +1 Charisma. If a Heroic Inspiration reroll fails, it isn't expended (but can't be reused on that test). Using Heroic Inspiration heals you by the die roll, with any excess as Temporary Hit Points.

name: Clout
description: +1 Strength. Advantage on Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks with warriors and martial folk, and add your Strength modifier to Inspiring Leader's Temporary Hit Points.

name: Cold Water Warrior
description: Automatically succeed on Strength checks to move through rough water. Immune to frigid water for hours equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Long and High Jumps while swimming (10 feet of swimming is a running start). Advantage on Initiative when starting combat partly submerged.

name: Combat Flyting
description: +1 Charisma. As a Bonus Action, taunt a creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand you: on a failed Charisma save (DC 8 + Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus) it takes -1 to attacks against you. Repeat each turn with a Bonus Action to stack penalties up to your Charisma modifier (new save each time). Ends if you drop to 0, are Incapacitated, skip a Bonus Action, it moves over 30 feet away, or after Proficiency Bonus rounds. A success grants 24-hour immunity.

name: Cut Down the Nithingr
description: +1 Strength or Charisma. +2 damage against Frightened creatures, and Frightened durations you cause are doubled.

name: Endurance Conditioning
description: +1 Constitution. Once per day a Short Rest removes 1 Exhaustion level, and a Long Rest removes 2.

name: Faster Crafting
description: +1 to any ability. Proficiency with an Artisan's Tool, or Advantage with one you already know. In combat, as a Bonus Action craft one item from the Fast Crafting table with proficient tools; it lasts until the end of your next turn or until you craft another. You can also craft one during a Short Rest, lasting until the end of the day or your next Long Rest.

name: Fjord Jumper
description: +1 Strength. Jump distances +10 feet, and Advantage on attacks, Acrobatics, and Athletics checks right after jumping at least 10 feet high or 20 feet long. When you fall into liquid, a Reaction and a DC 15 Athletics or Acrobatics check (with Advantage) negates the fall damage.

name: Frost Eyed
description: +1 Wisdom. Advantage on Perception checks in Bright Light and no Disadvantage on Perception in Dim Light. Proficiency in Survival, snow and ice count as normal terrain, and Advantage on Survival in snow or ice.

name: Frost-Touched
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. You know Frostbite or Ray of Frost, and always have Gust of Wind and one level 1 Cold-damage Druid, Sorcerer, or Wizard spell prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

name: Giant Slayer
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Within 5 feet of a Large or larger creature, Dodge as a Bonus Action. Large or larger creatures have Disadvantage on saves against your Topple mastery.

name: Greater Blessing of Baldur
description: +1 Dexterity or Constitution. After each Long Rest, gain Resistance to one damage type of your choice until your next Long Rest.

name: Greater Blessing of Boreas
description: +1 Strength or Constitution. Resistance to Cold damage, and when you would take Fire damage, use your Reaction to gain Resistance to Fire until the start of your next turn.

name: Greater Blessing of Freyr and Freyja
prerequisite: Level 4+, Blessing of Freyr and Freyja Feat
description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Cure Wounds always prepared, castable without a slot Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest or with slots; healing is doubled on Beasts and Plants.

name: Greater Blessing of Jormungandr
description: +1 Strength or Charisma. As an action, up to Proficiency Bonus creatures within 30 feet that can see you make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or are Frightened for 1 minute (save each turn). Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

name: Greater Blessing of Loki
description: +1 Intelligence or Charisma. Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks. Alter Self always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

name: Greater Blessing of Sif
description: +1 Dexterity or Constitution. As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute your ranged weapon hits deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per turn. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

name: Greater Blessing of Thor
description: +1 Strength or Constitution. As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute your melee weapon hits deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per turn. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

name: Greater Blessing of Wotan
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Advantage on checks with your Lore Bound skill. Augury always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

name: Heroic Rush
description: +1 Constitution or Charisma. On a Critical Hit, +10 feet Speed and Advantage on attacks until the end of your next turn. When you drop a creature to 0 with an attack, an ally within 30 feet gains Heroic Inspiration to use by the end of its next turn (twice per Short or Long Rest).

name: Holmganga Master
description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Advantage on Initiative at the start of a duel. As a Bonus Action, a successful Charisma (Intimidation) check against your duel opponent gives you Advantage on your next attack against it and it Disadvantage on its next attack against you.

name: Hunter
description: +1 Wisdom or Intelligence. Advantage on Perception and Survival checks to follow or identify tracks, and on Stealth checks outdoors.

name: Ice Mastery
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, when a spell of level 1+ deals Cold damage to a creature, add one: Disadvantage on Dexterity checks for 1 minute; Restrained in ice until it saves (Dexterity) or takes 10 Bludgeoning or Fire; or Vulnerability to Cold for 1 minute (Constitution save each turn).

name: Lightning Mastery
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, when a spell of level 1+ deals Lightning damage to a creature, add one: Stunned until the end of your next turn if it failed its save; half the Lightning damage again at the start of its next turn (save negates); or Vulnerability to Lightning for 1 minute (Constitution save each turn).

name: Living off the Land
description: +1 Constitution or Wisdom. A Long Rest in a natural area yields materials for a Healer's Kit and food for one Medium creature for a day. In 30 minutes build a shelter for 4 to 5 Medium humanoids; inside, they automatically succeed on saves against extreme cold and heat.

name: Long Haft Strike
description: +1 Strength. Reach weapon attacks ignore a target's Shield bonus to AC, and you have +1 AC while wielding a Reach weapon.

name: Moon-Touched
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. You know Dancing Lights or Light, and always have Moonbeam and one level 1 light spell from the Druid, Sorcerer, or Wizard list prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

name: Mounted Leap
prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+, Proficiency in Animal Handling
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Your mount's jump distance is doubled. Jumping from a moving mount uses its Speed if better; a melee hit after the jump adds 1d8 damage or knocks a target up to one size larger Prone (once per turn).

name: Northlands Hardiness
description: +1 Constitution. Advantage on saves against extreme cold (and against Cold damage if you already resist it). Your first Exhaustion level each day doesn't reduce your Speed, and you can ignore Exhaustion on a d20 Test.

name: Primal
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Barkskin and two of Animal Friendship, Entangle, Goodberry, or Speak with Animals always prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

name: Ravens' Friend
description: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom. Proficiency in Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion. Give yourself Advantage when you take the Study action, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

name: Spear Expert
prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+, Weapon Mastery class feature
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. +1 AC while holding a Spear, thrown Spear range 30/90, and Advantage on Readied Spear attacks.

name: Surtr's Touch
description: +1 Strength or Constitution. As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute your melee weapon hits deal extra Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

name: Trickster's Toolbox
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Hideous Laughter and two level 1 Enchantment or Illusion spells always prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

name: Wild Lore
description: +1 Intelligence. Advantage on Intelligence (Nature) checks, and you can find food and water for yourself and up to three others each day.

name: Glima
description: When you hit a creature within 5 feet that is no more than one size larger with an Unarmed Strike, you can force a Strength save (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Strength modifier) or it has the Prone condition.

name: Raider's Rush
description: If you move at least 15 feet and stop within 5 feet of an ally, you have Advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 feet of that ally.

name: Savagery
description: On your first melee weapon attack each turn, you can attack savagely: add your Proficiency Bonus to melee weapon damage rolls but take -2 AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Shield Wall
description: When a creature you can see hits an adjacent ally, use your Reaction to add your Shield's AC bonus to the ally against that attack. You and an adjacent ally both wielding shields each gain +1 AC.

name: Skirmisher
description: +10 feet Speed. Once per turn, after moving at least 15 feet, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage of a Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing hit.

name: Underfoot
description: You can end your move in the space of a creature two sizes larger. While sharing its space you have Advantage on attacks against it and it has Disadvantage on attacks against you.

name: Pouncing
description: After moving 15 feet or more toward a creature, +2 to your next Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike attack roll against it, or +2 to the save DC of a Grapple or Shove against it.

name: Born In Yatamon
prerequisite: Lived in Yatamon for at least 1 year
description: Proficiency in the Salvage skill (Expertise if already proficient). You learn Naku Naku and Torum. Twice per Long Rest, when targeted by a level 1+ spell from yourself or an ally, regain Hit Points equal to twice the spell's level. You learn one Wizard cantrip.

name: Connoisseur
description: +1 Constitution or Wisdom. A satisfying meal during a rest grants Heroic Inspiration or 1d10 + level Temporary Hit Points. Advantage on Charisma checks at formal events. Proficiency with Brewer's Supplies or Cook's Utensils, and 10 minutes identifies an ingredient's or potion's properties.

name: Feline Instincts
description: Advantage against the Prone condition, and standing costs at most 10 feet. Speak with felines as if by Speak with Animals. Add half your Proficiency Bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks, even if already proficient.

name: Haggler
description: +1 Intelligence or Charisma. When a creature within 10 feet fails a Charisma D20 Test, gain Advantage on your next Intimidation or Persuasion against it within an hour, or Heroic Inspiration (once per Long Rest). Reroll a failed Charisma check or save, but the DC rises by 3. 5 percent off purchases, and spend Heroic Inspiration for a further 10 + 1d10 percent.

name: Motorist
description: +1 Dexterity or Intelligence. Vehicles you drive get +1 AC, you add your Proficiency Bonus to Maneuvering checks, small vehicles count as Nimble and Simple for you, and you add it to ram save DCs.

name: Yoka Scout
prerequisite: Level 4+, Member of the Yoka Scouts
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. When an ally misses a creature within 10 feet of you, take a Reaction to let it reroll; if it hits, regain the Reaction (half Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest). +2 to ability checks an ally succeeded on in the last minute. Advantage on Search checks related to Demons.

name: Faithful
description: Once per Long Rest, turn a failed save against Charmed or Frightened into a success. Whenever you roll a 1 on a D20 Test, you gain Heroic Inspiration.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Grizzled
description: Add your Proficiency Bonus to saves against Frightened. You need half the food and water and have Advantage on Survival checks to forage. Once per Short or Long Rest, gain Heroic Inspiration right after damage makes you Bloodied.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Brutalizer
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Wield a Two-Handed weapon in one hand if the other hand holds no Two-Handed weapon or Shield. After attacking with a Two-Handed weapon in the Attack action, make a Bonus Action attack with a Light weapon (no ability modifier to damage unless negative or you have Two-Weapon Fighting).
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Cannoneer
description: +1 Strength. Proficiency with Cannons; reload one as a Bonus Action if you haven't moved (Speed 0 afterward). From level 11 it doesn't stop you and can replace an attack; at level 20 ignore the Artillery property. Double damage to objects and structures, and Cannons and Cannonballs weigh half for you.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: I Fought, I Lived
description: Once per Long Rest while Bloodied, treat a hit's damage roll as the maximum. If Frightened at the start of your turn, roll a d20; on 10 or higher the condition ends.

name: I Hid from the Terror
description: Attack without ending the Invisible condition, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. You can hide from larger creatures while lightly obscured or more than 30 feet away. Perception checks to detect you while Invisible have Disadvantage.

name: I Pierced the Illusion
description: If Charmed at the start of your turn, roll a d20; on 10 or higher it ends. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, tell whether an NPC speaking to you is knowingly lying. Advantage on Insight checks against creatures you are speaking with.

name: I Opened the Gate
description: Learn three languages. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, give a spell's save DC +2, but you are Paralyzed until the start of your next turn.

name: I Survived to Tell the Tale
description: Once per Long Rest when damage would drop you to 0, regain Hit Points equal to your level. +10 feet Speed. When you would be Grappled, roll a d20; on 10 or higher you aren't.

name: Aereni Expertise
description: Proficiency in one skill of your choice, and Expertise in that skill.

name: Aquatic Adaptation
description: You can breathe underwater (removing any Limited Amphibiousness dependence on water), gain proficiency in Athletics, and have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Envoy Specialist
description: Proficiency with one tool of your choice. One tool you're proficient with is built into your body and can't be removed; with a hand free you can use it, and add 1d4 to ability checks made with it.

name: Khesh'dar Training
description: Proficiency and Expertise in Stealth. When you take the Hide action, the DC to succeed is 10.

name: Focused Personas
description: Define two personas. Adept Persona: while in it, proficiency with a chosen tool and +1d4 to checks with it. Expert Persona: while in it, Expertise in a chosen skill you're proficient in. You also know Skin Cant.

name: Thoughtsinger
description: Your Mind Link reaches 120 feet or 10 times your level. You can message everyone you're linked to at once and let them talk telepathically with each other, and you can Help an ally's attack from any distance while linked.

name: Uul Dhakaan
prerequisite: Dhakaani Ghaal'dar, Dhakaani Golin'dar, or Dhakaani Guul'dar
description: You dream lucidly and remember your dreams. A spirit mentor in the Uul Dhakaan may send visions, missions, or clues after a Long Rest. Resistance to Psychic damage.

name: Aereni Half-Life
description: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom. Advantage on Death Saving Throws, Resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage, and spells that deal Necrotic can deal Radiant instead.

name: Changeling Metamorphosis
description: +1 Constitution or Dexterity. +1 AC. Each time you use Shape-Shifter, gain one until you shift again: gills and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed; Darkvision 60 feet; or natural weapons (claws, fangs, horns, or hooves) dealing 1d6 with your Unarmed Strike, using Strength or Dexterity.

name: Juggernaut Plating
description: +1 Strength or Constitution. Armor you wear can't be targeted by effects against your will while you live, and Critical Hits against you become normal hits.

name: Quori Bond
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Pick a quori lineage: Du'ulora (Intimidation, Crown of Madness), Hashalaq (Persuasion, Suggestion), Kalaraq (Perception, Mind Spike), or Tsucora (Intimidation, Shatter dealing Psychic). Add 1d4 to checks with that skill; the spell is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots.

name: Superior Shifting
description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom. You can shift at the start of your turn with no action, shifting lasts 10 minutes, and you gain one extra use (one use back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest).

name: Siberys Mark of Detection
description: Advantage on Investigation checks. True Seeing is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Finding
description: Advantage on Perception checks. Commune with Nature and Find the Path are always prepared, each free once per Short Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Handling
description: Advantage on Animal Handling checks. Dominate Beast is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots; you have Advantage on its Concentration checks, it lasts up to 8 hours, and you can hold it while asleep. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Healing
description: Advantage on Medicine checks. Heal is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Hospitality
description: Advantage on Persuasion checks. Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Making
description: Advantage on Investigation checks. Fabricate (free once per Short Rest) and Create Homunculus (free once per Long Rest) are always prepared and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Passage
description: Advantage on Acrobatics checks. Teleport is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Scribing
description: Advantage on Insight checks and Calligrapher's Supplies checks. Symbol is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Sentinel
description: Advantage on Perception checks. Globe of Invulnerability is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Shadow
description: Advantage on Stealth checks. Project Image is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Storm
description: Advantage on Acrobatics checks and Navigator's Tools checks. Control Weather is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Siberys Mark of Warding
description: Advantage on Investigation checks and Thieves' Tools checks. Forbiddance is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

name: Ashbound Initiate
description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Proficiency in Intimidation. When a creature you can see casts a spell, you have Advantage on attacks against it until the end of your next turn. With slots of each level, always prepared: Guiding Bolt, Shining Smite, Nondetection, Aura of Purity, Circle of Power.

name: Gatekeeper Initiate
description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Proficiency in Arcana. Add 1d4 to saves against an Aberration's spells or magical abilities. With slots of each level, always prepared: Detect Evil and Good, Warding Bond, Magic Circle, Banishment, Dispel Evil and Good.

name: Greensinger Initiate
description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Proficiency in Performance. When you Charm a creature, use your Reaction to move half your Speed without provoking. Your spells and abilities that affect Humanoids also affect Fey. With slots of each level, always prepared: Tasha's Hideous Laughter, Enthrall, Major Image, Compulsion, Mislead.

name: Hewn for Battle
description: +1 Strength or Constitution. After a rest, set unarmored AC to 14 + Dexterity or 18 (shields still apply); your hide can be enchanted like armor; claws deal 1d6 + Strength Slashing with Unarmed Strikes.

name: Orb Expert
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. After a rest roll 1d6; once before it's lost, add it to a spell attack through an Orb or subtract it from one target's save. Holding an Orb, Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage, and when a creature enters within 5 feet you can use your Reaction to move your Speed without provoking.

name: Rod Expert
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Through a Rod: reroll 1s and 2s on cantrip damage against targets within 20 feet, no Disadvantage on ranged spell attacks within 5 feet of an enemy, and after a ranged spell attack, a Bonus Action melee attack with the Rod as a Club.

name: Shadow's Gift of Stone
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. The Medusa Spells (Ensnaring Strike, Hold Person, Hypnotic Pattern, Stoneskin, Hold Monster) are always prepared as you reach their levels, each free once per Long Rest and castable with slots, using your Petrifying Gaze ability.

name: Staff Expert
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Through a Staff: Bonus Action to double a spell's range, reroll 1s and 2s on cantrip damage, and if every target is beyond half range, one creature you hit or that fails its save is knocked Prone.

name: Stone Eyes
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. When a creature you Restrained or Paralyzed fails its save to end it by 5 or more, you can Petrify it for 1 minute with Concentration; held the full minute, it stays stone until Greater Restoration.

name: Voice of the Fury
description: +1 Dexterity, Wisdom, or Charisma. The Harpy Spells (Charm Person, Suggestion, Enemies Abound, Charm Monster, Dominate Person) are always prepared as you reach their levels, each free once per Long Rest and castable with slots, using your Harpy's Charms ability.

name: Wand Expert
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Through a Wand: Advantage on spell attacks against targets that haven't taken a turn, no Disadvantage on ranged spell attacks within 5 feet of an enemy, and drawing or stowing a Wand is free.

name: Warden Initiate
description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Proficiency in Animal Handling. Once per Short or Long Rest, when a creature hits another within 5 feet of you, use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d6 + Proficiency Bonus. With slots of each level, always prepared: Sanctuary, Detect Thoughts, Blink, Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound, Hold Monster.

name: Wings of Stone
description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. You have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Winter Initiate
description: +1 Wisdom or Constitution. Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus after taking Necrotic damage, and creatures you conjure can be Undead. With slots of each level, always prepared: False Life, Ray of Enfeeblement, Bestow Curse, Death Ward, Enervation.

name: Wandslinger
description: +1 to attack rolls with spells, and +1 to the save DC of your cantrips.

name: Naturalist
description: Survival rolls of 1 to 9 count as 10 when identifying remains; Expertise in Survival when tracking beasts; the first time you meet a new beast, learn its AC, maximum HP, or one Resistance.

name: Miner
description: A belt lamp (20 feet bright, 20 dim); Tremorsense 30 feet underground (+20 if you already have it); Advantage on checks and saves to escape falling natural rock.

name: Stone-Whisperer
description: +1 Wisdom. Cast Stone Shape without materials or a slot once per day (3 at level 10, 5 at 15, unlimited at 20). Tremorsense 10 feet.

name: Behaviourist
description: +1 Intelligence. Expertise in Animal Handling, and creatures you tame gain +1 to AC, attack rolls, and damage.

name: Crocodile Wrangler
description: +1 Strength or Constitution. Advantage on Animal Handling, Beasts have Disadvantage on saves against your Grapple, and a Small to Large Beast you grapple can't target you.

name: Volcanologist
description: +1 Intelligence or Constitution. Resistance to Fire. Study a visible volcano for 10 minutes to estimate when it will erupt, and the safe distance if within 7 days.

name: Action Hero
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. When a bite or maw attack hits you, use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your level. Your first failed Athletics check each day succeeds instead.

name: Arcane Enchanter
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. As an Action, enchant one touched item for 1 minute: a weapon deals +1d6 of a damage type your spells deal (+PB at 16); armor grants Resistance to one such type (two at 16); a wondrous item grants Advantage against one condition (two at 16). One enchantment at a time.
